visual_probe.algorithm: 256-bit grayscale difference hash (17x16 resized source; adjacent-pixel comparisons)
visual_probe.result: No exact-byte or strong visual near-duplicate pair was found in the reviewed candidate pool.

near_duplicate_review.limitation: Different pages by the same creator, adjacent chapter pages, recolors, and alternate-language typesetting can be visually dissimilar. This probe is evidence against direct image duplication, not proof of source-family independence.

passed: The four visually reviewed new ZH pages satisfy the required four-page multi-panel/conventional-balloon stratum.
No exact source-byte duplicate or close dHash duplicate was found in the reviewed candidate pool.

blocking: The candidate pool does not establish four independently proven ZH creator/series families; one is proven and two clusters remain unattributed.
The KO pool establishes only three independent creators and contains conflicting translator-caption versus source-post attribution.
A09 has no frozen 24-page source/label/threshold manifest. The existing A07 labels apply only to development fixtures and cannot be reused for holdout candidates.
